title: Global well-posedness for the 2D primitive equations with subcritical horizontal dissipation
summary: We establish global well-posedness of classical solutions to the two-dimensional primitive equations with fractional horizontal dissipation for arbitrarily large initial data in the full subcritical range $1<α\leq2$. Together with the known ill-posedness results for $0\leqα<1$, this establishes the sharp dissipation threshold for large-data global well-posedness in the corresponding solution framework. The key ingredient is a hydrostatic energy estimate obtained by splitting the nonlinear energy into symmetric and antisymmetric parts and exploiting the commutator structure of the latter.…
